evidence.note: Diagnosed that the `is_record` predicate was structurally wrong for ABI decisions and replaced it with `is_aggregate` at all ABI sites — a root-cause abstraction fix, not a local patch.
Followed up by searching for other 'aggregate-ish checks' and applying `is_aggregate` broadly, showing recognition that the same classification limitation recurred and warranted a systemic fix.
Added a whole complex-number type category spanning types.rs, parser, sema, ast and codegen — extending the representation across layers when the feature didn't fit, rather than special-casing.
Reworked types.rs / parser for vector types when vector torture tests were falsifying the current type model, adjusting representation rather than patching around it.
Cross-layer changes for nested functions and struct-return ABI (adjusting scratch-register handling in codegen) after nestfunc failures — targeted structural adjustment following diagnosis.
Long run of purely local codegen edits; much of the mid-game is incremental symptom-level fixing rather than structural pivots, keeping this below the highest anchors.

reasoning: The agent started from a reasonably extensible architecture (real type representation, staged passes), so it rarely faced a falsified foundation; when features didn't fit it extended representation across all layers (complex, vector, designated inits, alignment) rather than hacking single sites, and in the is_record→is_aggregate case it diagnosed a mis-scoped abstraction and broadened it at all ABI sites — behavior between anchors 5 and 8. It never barreled ahead on a broken assumption, but the visible reasoning about trade-offs is absent (prose stripped) and much of the arc is local patching, so it falls short of the sustained 'continuously reconciles design with reality' 8-10 band. I place it at 6.
